nodes.name: sap_java_secstore_offline.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python offline decryption of SAP AS Java SecStore: PKCS12 KDF + 3DES-CBC PBE that turns SecStore.key/properties and J2EE_CONFIGENTRY VBYTES into plaintext credentials.
nodes.languageNotes: Ports ERPScan algorithm; uses pycryptodome plus hashlib with no SAP SDK dependency.

nodes.name: sap_java_secstore_runner.py
nodes.summary: Massive single-function orchestrator extract_java_secstore that handles JSP drop, server-side SecStoreFS reflection decrypt, fallback offline decryption, and SAPNode population.
nodes.languageNotes: Entire 1180-line module is a single function — historical extract from sapmap_exploit.py umbrella module.

nodes.name: sap_oa2c.py
nodes.summary: OAuth 2.0 Client profile harvester that mines OA2C_CLIENT/EXT/PROFILES tables via DDIF_FIELDINFO_GET, RFC_READ_TABLE, and ABAP-installand-run fallbacks to recover token-endpoint metadata for BTP token minting.

nodes.name: sap_scc_harvest.py
nodes.summary: Post-RCE Cloud Connector harvest: from a pwned ABAP/Java node it pulls SCC backups, hashes, and subaccount mappings via OS exec channels and the LPE primitive.

nodes.name: sapmap_scc_admin.py
nodes.summary: Authenticated SAP Cloud Connector REST helpers (Tomcat j_security_check login, subaccount/mapping/HA pulls, default-credential probe) implemented read-only over urllib.

nodes.name: sapmap_scc_keystore.py
nodes.summary: SCC trust-store / keystore extraction: pulls /api/v1/configuration/backup, parses keystores, mappings, PP config/trust, HA state, and user hashes from the resulting zip.

nodes.name: sapmap_scc_ssfs_decrypt.py
nodes.summary: Two-stage SCC SSFS post-processing: decrypts SSFS records (pure-Python or via the JNI helper jar), recovers JAVA_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, then unlocks every .p12 in the backup loot.

nodes.name: _pkcs12_kdf
nodes.summary: Implements the PKCS12 key-derivation routine SAP uses to derive 3DES key + IV from the keyphrase.

nodes.name: _pbe_decrypt_3des_cbc
nodes.summary: PBE-based 3DES-CBC decryption used to unwrap the SecStore VBYTES.

nodes.name: deobfuscate_seckey
nodes.summary: Removes SAP's obfuscation from a raw SecStore.key blob to recover the keyphrase bytes and version flag.

nodes.name: decrypt_vbytes
nodes.summary: Decrypts a single VBYTES hex blob from J2EE_CONFIGENTRY into plaintext bytes using the recovered keyphrase.

nodes.name: decrypt_secstore_properties
nodes.summary: Decrypts every property in a SecStore.properties file to a {key: plaintext} dict.

nodes.name: extract_java_secstore
nodes.summary: Massive single-function orchestrator: deploys SecStore JSP, runs server-side SecStoreFS decrypt, falls back to offline 3DES decryption, and populates SAPNode credentials/findings.

nodes.name: _pick
nodes.summary: Substring-matches the first populated column in a row whose name matches any of the provided hints.

nodes.name: _read_table_all_columns
nodes.summary: Reads every column of a table via RFC_READ_TABLE so kernel-drift in column names does not break the harvest.

nodes.name: _try_read_first_populated
nodes.summary: Iterates candidate column hints and returns the first one that produces non-empty data.

nodes.name: _columns_matching_hints
nodes.summary: Returns the set of column names in a table matching any of the substring hints provided.

nodes.name: _reread_with_explicit_columns
nodes.summary: Re-reads a table with an explicit column list once the harvester has confirmed which columns exist.

nodes.name: _read_via_abap_fallback
nodes.summary: Falls back to RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN when RFC_READ_TABLE is blocked by S_TABU_DIS authorisation.

nodes.name: read_oa2c_profiles
nodes.summary: Public entry that harvests OA2C_CLIENT/EXT/PROFILES rows via the DDIF/RFC_READ_TABLE/INSTALL_AND_RUN chain and returns structured profiles.

nodes.name: find_secret_for_profile
nodes.summary: Locates the matching /OA2C/CS_<UUID>_NN SecStore entry that holds the client_secret for a given OAuth2 profile.

nodes.name: _b64_only
nodes.summary: Strips non-base64 noise from a captured stdout blob before decoding.

nodes.name: harvest_scc_from_pwned_node
nodes.summary: Massive post-RCE routine that uses execute_gw_command / run_os_command from a pwned node to locate the SCC install, pull config/backup files, and structure them into findings.

nodes.name: harvest_scc_hashes_via_lpe
nodes.summary: Variant harvester that uses the LPE-acquired admin context to dump SCC user hashes from local files.

nodes.name: harvest_scc_mappings_from_pwned_node
nodes.summary: Reads SCC subaccount/mapping configuration from a compromised SCC host so the cloud-side trust graph can be drawn.

nodes.name: _build_session
nodes.summary: Creates an urllib opener with cookie jar and SSL context customised for SCC Tomcat endpoints.

nodes.name: _request
nodes.summary: Wrapped request helper that adds auth headers and uniform error handling.

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Performs the Tomcat j_security_check form-auth dance against the SCC admin UI and returns an authenticated SCCAdminSession.

nodes.name: _get_v1_subaccounts_raw
nodes.summary: Issues the /api/v1/subaccounts GET request, returning the raw response.

nodes.name: _get_backends_raw
nodes.summary: Issues the /api/v1/backends GET request for raw backend data.

nodes.name: _get_versions_raw
nodes.summary: Issues the GET that returns the SCC version/build info.

nodes.name: pull_subaccounts
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that calls the subaccounts endpoint and normalises the JSON into a list.

nodes.name: _is_pp_auth_mode
nodes.summary: Tests whether a mapping is configured for principal-propagation auth mode.

nodes.name: _normalize_mapping
nodes.summary: Converts the SCC mapping JSON shape into SAPMAP's canonical SCCMapping dict used by the rest of the codebase.

nodes.name: _fetch_resources
nodes.summary: Pulls the list of resources allowed under a mapping, used to draw resource-level edges in the graph.

nodes.name: pull_mappings
nodes.summary: Pulls every backend mapping under a given subaccount, normalises them, and attaches resource lists.

nodes.name: pull_ha_state
nodes.summary: Reads the SCC HA cluster state (shadow connectivity, peer health) so HA topology can be visualised.

nodes.name: probe_default_creds
nodes.summary: Iterates a small list of default SCC credentials (Administrator/manage, etc.) against the login endpoint to surface weak deployments.

nodes.name: fetch_backup
nodes.summary: Calls POST /api/v1/configuration/backup with the passphrase to download the SCC configuration zip.

nodes.name: parse_backup
nodes.summary: Walks the backup zip, classifying each entry (config, scc_config, users.xml, SSFS) for downstream parsing.

nodes.name: _parse_resources_xml
nodes.summary: Parses resources.xml inside the backup into structured per-mapping resource lists.

nodes.name: parse_mappings_from_backends_xml
nodes.summary: Reads backends.xml from the backup and emits SCCMapping records, used when the REST API is unavailable.

nodes.name: parse_mappings_from_zip
nodes.summary: Generic helper that scans the entire backup zip for mapping definitions across SCC versions.

nodes.name: parse_pp_config_from_zip
nodes.summary: Extracts principal-propagation configuration (subjects, CA, lifetime) from the backup zip.

nodes.name: parse_pp_trust_from_zip
nodes.summary: Extracts PP trust configuration including trusted issuers and per-subaccount CA fingerprints.

nodes.name: parse_ha_state_from_zip
nodes.summary: Reads HA-cluster state files persisted inside the backup to mirror the live REST endpoint when offline.

nodes.name: parse_user_hashes_from_xml
nodes.summary: Parses users.xml — when it is in plaintext form — into hashed credential records.

nodes.name: try_decrypt_users_xml
nodes.summary: Attempts to decrypt the encrypted users.xml variant emitted by newer SCC backups; backlog item per project memory.

nodes.name: extract_keystore
nodes.summary: Public entry point that downloads the backup zip, parses every artifact, and persists results to the loot directory.

nodes.name: find_helper_jar
nodes.summary: Searches conventional locations for tools/ssfs_decrypt/decrypt-ssfs.jar required by the JNI path.

nodes.name: find_native_lib
nodes.summary: Searches for libsapscc20jni.so / sapscc20jni.dll on disk for the JNI helper.

nodes.name: _detect_ssfs_sid
nodes.summary: Detects the SID embedded in the SSFS key/data filenames to scope decryption properly.

nodes.name: _extract_ssfs_to_tmp
nodes.summary: Unpacks the SSFS_SCC.KEY and SSFS_SCC.DAT files into a temp directory ready for decryption.

nodes.name: _parse_ssfs_records
nodes.summary: Parses the SSFS binary record layout into a list of (key, raw value) tuples for downstream decryption.

nodes.name: decrypt_ssfs_pure
nodes.summary: Pure-Python SSFS decryption path that works without JDK or libsapscc20jni; preferred default per project memory.

nodes.name: decrypt_ssfs_from_raw_bytes
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that takes raw SSFS bytes (not a file path) and returns plaintext records.

nodes.name: decrypt_ssfs
nodes.summary: Top-level SSFS decryption dispatcher that prefers the pure-Python path and falls back to the JNI helper jar when needed.

nodes.name: unlock_keystores
nodes.summary: Loads every .p12 in the SCC loot using the JAVA_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD recovered from SSFS, recording alias/cert/private-key fingerprints.

nodes.name: decrypt_and_unlock
nodes.summary: Public entry that runs SSFS decryption then keystore unlock end-to-end, returning the structured findings dict.
